module TopModule(
  input  clk,
  input  areset,
  input  bump_left,
  input  bump_right,
  input  ground,
  input  dig,
  output reg walk_left,
  output reg walk_right,
  output reg aaah,
  output reg digging
);
  reg walk_left_next, walk_right_next;
  wire bumped = bump_left | bump_right;
  wire falling = !ground;
  wire digging_next = dig & ground & !falling;
  always @(*) begin
    case ({walk_left, walk_right})
      2'b00: begin walk_left_next = 1; walk_right_next = 0; end
      2'b01: begin walk_left_next = 0; walk_right_next = 1; end
      2'b10: begin walk_left_next = 1; walk_right_next = 0; end
      2'b11: begin walk_left_next = 0; walk_right_next = 1; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (areset) begin walk_left <= 1; walk_right <= 0; aaah <= 0; digging <= 0; end
    else begin
      walk_left <= walk_left_next;
      walk_right <= walk_right_next;
      aaah <= falling;
      digging <= digging_next;
      if (bumped) begin
        if (bump_left) walk_right_next <= 1;
        if (bump_right) walk_left_next <= 1;
      end
      else if (falling) begin walk_left_next <= walk_left; walk_right_next <= walk_right; end
      else if (digging) begin
        if (ground) begin walk_left_next <= walk_left; walk_right_next <= walk_right; end
        else begin walk_left_next <= 0; walk_right_next <= 0; aaah <= 1; end
      end
    end
  end
endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  bump_left,
    input  bump_right,
    input  ground,
    input  dig,
    output reg walk_left,
    output reg walk_right,
    output reg aaah,
    output reg digging
);
    reg [2:0] state, next_state;
    always @(*) begin
        case (state)
            3'b000: next_state = ground ? 3'b001 : 3'b010; // walk left
            3'b001: next_state = ground ? 3'b010 : (bump_right ? 3'b011 : 3'b001); // fall, dig or walk right
            3'b010: next_state = ground ? 3'b000 : (bump_left ? 3'b011 : 3'b010); // fall, dig or walk left
            3'b011: next_state = ground ? (dig ? 3'b101 : (bump_right ? 3'b011 : (bump_left ? 3'b010 : 3'b000))) : 3'b010; // fall, dig or walk left
            3'b101: next_state = ground ? 3'b110 : 3'b101; // dig
            3'b110: next_state = ground ? (bump_right ? 3'b011 : (bump_left ? 3'b010 : 3'b000)) : 3'b110; // fall or walk left or right
            default: next_state = 3'b000;
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 3'b000;
        else state <= next_state;
    end
    always @(*) begin
        walk_left = state[0];
        walk_right = state[1];
        aaah = state[2];
        digging = (state == 3'b101);
    end
endmodule
